facility.instrument_class: committed equity facility / primary equity financing; not debt
facility.purchase_price_formula: 97% of applicable VWAP, subject to contractual conditions and special block-trade treatment for notices above 20% of volume
facility.issuer_discretion: Evernorth may elect to sell all, some or none of the shares to Cantor.

purchase_limits.threshold_price: greater of $1.00, 90% of prior trading-day close, or a higher issuer-specified threshold

registration_conditions.remaining_contractual_conditions: Other purchase conditions still apply; no purchase notice is established by these filings.

facility.fee_due_rule: Within five business days after the SEC effectiveness date.

xrp_use_of_proceeds.issuer_statement: Evernorth says it expects a substantial portion of any proceeds from the facility to be used to acquire additional XRP.
xrp_use_of_proceeds.market_impact: Potential future XRP demand only if Evernorth elects to draw, Cantor purchases shares, and Evernorth subsequently buys XRP. Purchase venue, timing, amount and execution method are undisclosed.

proceeds_reconciliation.finding: The $80.7M summary figure approximately matches 5,218,935 shares at the earlier $15.46 reference price before the 3% discount. The $76.8M figure approximately matches 5,218,935 shares at $14.71 before the discount. At $14.71, 97% produces approximately $74.47M, close to the stated $74.4M net amount before accounting for stated fees. The filing's values and footnote do not reconcile cleanly; this is preserved as a source-internal inconsistency, not repaired by inference.
proceeds_reconciliation.treatment: Do not average, select as actual proceeds, or treat as cash raised.

dilution.interpretation: If all shares are issued, new shares represent approximately 16.7% of post-issuance Class A shares; actual dilution depends on how many shares are sold.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The facility could become a future source of XRP buying capital.
competing_hypotheses.support: Final prospectus says a substantial portion of any facility proceeds is expected to acquire additional XRP; SEC EFFECT and final prospectus were both dated October 30.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence: Evernorth may draw all, some or none; no purchase notice, draw or XRP purchase is disclosed.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The facility's headline $80.7M/$76.8M figures overstate or obscure likely realized proceeds.
competing_hypotheses.support: The final filing contains conflicting amounts and a 97% pricing formula that does not reconcile with every illustrative row.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence: Actual purchase prices depend on future VWAP and the number of shares sold; the prospectus expressly labels the amounts as assumptions.

reasons: This is a financing capacity and intended-use event, not an executed XRP purchase.
Actual draw and XRP acquisition timestamps/amounts are absent.
The filing's illustrative proceeds values are internally inconsistent.

source_records.normalized_excerpt: On October 23, 2026, Evernorth entered into a Common Stock Purchase Agreement with CF Principal Investments LLC, giving Evernorth the right at its option to sell up to 5,218,935 newly issued Class A shares. The purchase price is 97% of applicable VWAP, subject to limits. The upfront commitment fee is $521,893.50 and is fully earned and non-refundable regardless of whether purchases are made.
limitations: Issuer summary of agreement; full agreement exhibits govern.
The filing describes an optional equity facility, not debt and not a completed share sale.

source_records.normalized_excerpt: SEC Form EFFECT for Evernorth Holdings Inc., file number 333-299620, states an effectiveness date of October 30, 2026 at 4:00 p.m.
limitations: The EFFECT notice establishes registration-statement effectiveness, not that Evernorth delivered a purchase notice or Cantor bought shares.

source_records.normalized_excerpt: We intend to use any proceeds from the Facility for general corporate purposes, including the acquisition of XRP and other activities within the XRP ecosystem, as well as working capital. Consistent with our business strategy, we expect that a substantial portion of any such proceeds will be used to acquire additional XRP.
limitations: This is a prospective statement of intended use, not evidence of an actual draw or XRP purchase.

source_records.normalized_excerpt: Any sales by the Holder under the prospectus are for the Holder's account and Evernorth receives no proceeds from those resales. If all 5,218,935 shares are sold to Cantor under the Purchase Agreement, Evernorth may receive up to approximately $76.8 million gross and estimates up to $74.4 million net over approximately 14 months after estimated fees and expenses.
limitations: The amounts are conditional illustrations, not actual proceeds.
The issuer's proceeds arise from issuing/selling shares to Cantor, not from Cantor's later public resales.

source_records.normalized_excerpt: The October 30, 2026 Form 424B3 summary Use of Proceeds table states approximately $80.7 million gross proceeds, while the cover and later Use of Proceeds section state approximately $76.8 million. The illustrative table at a $14.71 assumed trading price also states $76.8 million although its footnote says the purchase price uses 97% of the assumed trading price.
limitations: The filing does not explain the conflicting illustrative values.
Do not select one amount as actual or average them.

provenance.hash_scope: Normalized excerpts in source_records, not original SEC filing bytes.
